Luxury Apartments in Paphos by Motive Point
A significant part of the Motive Point portfolio is centred around the Venara developments in the Tombs of the Kings area of Paphos.

This location is particularly attractive to buyers who want to live close to the Mediterranean without being isolated from the city. Beaches, supermarkets, restaurants, schools and other daily amenities can be reached easily from the neighbourhood, making it suitable not only for holidays but also for longer stays and permanent living.
Venara — Contemporary Apartments Near the Sea

Venara is a boutique residential development comprising 27 apartments close to the Paphos coastline. The Mediterranean is approximately 500 metres away, while local shops, restaurants and other amenities are also nearby.

The project combines private residential space with a comparatively extensive range of communal facilities. Depending on the individual residence and specification, features include VRV climate control, underfloor heating, smart-home technology, photovoltaic systems, private parking and storage.
Residents also have access to leisure facilities including indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a gym and landscaped communal areas.
This makes Venara particularly relevant for buyers looking for a new-build apartment in Paphos with a higher specification than a conventional small residential block.
Venara View — New-Build Apartments in Tombs of the Kings
Venara View follows a more intimate residential format while retaining the benefits of the same coastal Paphos location.

The development includes contemporary apartments with one to three bedrooms and is situated approximately 500 metres from the sea. Specifications published for the project include underfloor heating, VRV air conditioning, a communal swimming pool and energy-efficient construction.
For buyers searching for a modern apartment in Paphos close to the beach but within an urban neighbourhood, Venara View offers an interesting balance between location, specification and scale.
Venara Lifestyle — Resort-Style Living in Paphos
Venara Lifestyle expands the concept further by placing a stronger emphasis on shared lifestyle and wellness facilities.
The development is planned with landscaped outdoor areas together with facilities such as swimming pools, a heated indoor pool, sauna, gym, outdoor exercise areas and spaces for recreation.

For buyers comparing new apartments in Paphos, this distinction matters. Two properties may have similar floor areas and bedroom counts while offering very different day-to-day living environments. The quality of common areas, climate systems, storage, parking and recreational facilities should therefore be considered alongside the apartment itself.
Motive Point Villas in Konia, Paphos
Motive Point’s portfolio is not limited to apartments.

In Konia, above Paphos, buyers can also consider an exclusive collection of only seven private villas. Their elevated hillside position provides expansive views across Paphos and towards the Mediterranean, including the harbour and coastline.

Konia offers a very different proposition from a coastal apartment. Instead of prioritising walkability to the beach, these homes emphasise privacy, larger internal and external spaces, panoramic views and a quieter residential setting.
The area is therefore worth considering for buyers searching for a luxury villa in Paphos for permanent living, a second home or simply a property with more space than a city apartment can provide.
